newsitem.title: USA: Health Power results hurt by pricing.
newsitem.headline: Health Power results hurt by pricing.

text.p: Health Power Inc said on Monday that its HMO subsidiary operations continue to operate at a loss due primarily to pricing caused by intense competition in both the public and private sectors.
"Margins will continue to suffer in the HMO until rates are increased," Thomas Beaty, president of the company, said in a press release.
The company said that its full-service workers' and unemployment compensation consulting business continues to exceed its expectations in terms of both growth and profitability during 1996.
Health Power reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.38 a share, compared to a loss of $0.21 the previous fourth quarter.
